commands.run_load: Measure CSS and JS coverage on page load
commands.start: Start measuring CSS and JS coverage
commands.stop: Stop measuring CSS and JS coverage

errors.none: No coverage measured yet: run Measure page load or Start first.
errors.running: A coverage measurement is running already.

findings.function-unused: The function {name} in {file} (at {offset}) ran in no view during the session.
findings.rule-partial: {selector} in {file} is used only at {breakpoints}, not at {unused}.
findings.unused-file: {file} is {percent} % unused in every view ({total} bytes): split it or load it only where it is needed.

panel.caption: Unused bytes per file, the least of any breakpoint, largest first
panel.noSource: The source of a script is not shown; its functions are listed.
panel.running: Measuring - interact in the views, then stop.
panel.spanTitle: The breakpoints differ: {from} % to {to} % unused. The value is the least, what every breakpoint leaves unused.
panel.summary: {mode} measurement, {views, plural, one {# breakpoint} other {# breakpoints}} measured, {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}: per file the bytes unused in every breakpoint that loads it.
panel.truncated: Showing the first files only; MCP coverage_get lists them all.
panel.viaScript: Style sheet, delivered as a script module (a dev server such as Vite)

rules.rule-partial: CSS rule used only at some breakpoints
rules.unused-file: File mostly unused in every view

defaultMode.description: What coverage_get measures without a mode: Page load reloads every view and measures, Interaction reads the running session.
defaultMode.help: What coverage_get measures without a mode: Page load reloads every view and measures the fresh load, Interaction reads what the running session has used so far.
defaultMode.label: Default mode

idleMs.description: A reloaded page counts as loaded once no new request came for this many milliseconds.
idleMs.help: A reloaded page counts as loaded once no new request came for this many milliseconds; then the measurement stops. Raise it for pages that load in waves.
idleMs.label: Network idle time

ignore.description: Files left out: URL patterns where * stands for any characters, such as */vendor/* or *.min.js.
ignore.help: Files left out of the report, as URL patterns where * stands for any characters. Example: */vendor/*, *.min.js.
ignore.label: Ignored files

loadTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a view may take to load again before its measurement fails.
loadTimeoutSeconds.help: How long a view may take to reload before its measurement fails, in seconds. Raise it for heavy pages.
loadTimeoutSeconds.label: Load timeout

minBytes.description: A file smaller than this, in bytes (UTF-16 units, as DevTools counts), gets no unused-file warning.
minBytes.help: A file smaller than this, in bytes, gets no unused-file warning, so tiny helpers do not clutter the report. Example: 10240 for 10 KiB.
minBytes.label: Smallest file reported

thirdParty.description: Measure files from other origins than the page's (CDNs, analytics).
thirdParty.help: Also measures files from other origins than the page's, such as CDNs and analytics. When off, it reports the site's own files only.
thirdParty.label: Third-party files

unusedPercent.description: A file with more than this share unused, in percent, in every view that loads it is reported.
unusedPercent.help: A file with more than this share unused, in percent, in every view that loads it is reported. Example: 50. Lower it to find more candidates for splitting.
unusedPercent.label: Unused share reported

tools.file: One file of the last measurement in detail, a window of up to 16000 characters at a time: per view its used ranges; for a style sheet its text and rules with the views using each; for a script its functions with the views that ran each.
tools.get: Unused CSS and JavaScript per view and file: total, used and unused units (UTF-16, as DevTools counts) of every style sheet and script. mode load reloads every view and measures once the network is idle; delta reads what the running interaction session used so far; last returns the last measurement. Includes the coverage findings.
tools.start: Starts CSS rule usage tracking and precise JavaScript coverage in the views (Chromium only) for an interaction session; stop it with coverage_stop.
tools.stop: Ends the interaction session in every view (tracking stopped), keeps its result as the last measurement and returns it with the findings.
